policy.aliasSearch: Retain every suppressed label and all existing aliases as canonical search aliases.
policy.historicalIds: Every original and supplemental ID must remain in exerciseById/history validation; duplicates may be excluded only from selectable browse/search rows.
policy.historicalMeasurements: Do not reinterpret or migrate persisted set values through a canonical alias. Separate selectableMetric from preserved historical metrics.
policy.licenses: When adopting another member guide, keep its author/license/source attached to that guide, not only canonical record metadata.
policy.variants: Preserve grip, angle, equipment, unilateral/bilateral and ROM distinctions. Mirrored execution-side names may share selection identity while old IDs stay valid.

scope: Read-only curation audit. All 1,661 catalog names and equipment reviewed; 283 semantic candidate families examined against sourced guides, with clear subsets accepted and remaining uncertain/distinct variants retained. No repository/deployment/credential access beyond reading catalog and AGENT.md.
